description: The local policy (SEC-10 to SEC-14) against a valid compiled config: `{ok: true}`, `policy_violation` (the config goes beyond the policy — the bundle is rejected, SEC-11) or `policy_invalid` (the policy file itself is malformed; the gate serves nothing). Hosts are keyed as `host[:port]`; a path prefix matches the same path or a path continuing at a "/" boundary.

cases.name: prefix matches only at a segment boundary
secret not bound to the upstream host (SEC-35)
secret bound only to another host (SEC-35)
an upstream without routes may not carry a secret to an unlisted host (SEC-35)
an upstream without auth needs no secret binding
policy secret name not a name
policy limit with an extra key
the counter store fits the worst case (SEC-27)
a per-IP window too long for the counter store (SEC-27)
a whole-route limit needs one counter
policy quota per month for the whole gate (FR-31, T-07)
policy quota with an unknown period
quotas count against the counter store (SEC-27)
the policy alone may not overflow the store (SEC-27)
a looser route limit is allowed: the policy limits still apply (T-21)
host budget and a route budget in the same format
route budget in another format than the host budget
host budget, but a route there may answer text (T-07)
